name: Spec-Authoring DNIS Composition
description: Composition profile that extends both profile:spec-authoring:0.1 and profile:dnis:0.1 so a single project can hold spec-authoring's typed primitives (Document, Stakeholder, ADR, Reference, ...) AND a DNIS Node tree (dnis:Document + dnis:Node) for graph-derived section numbering. Build scripts that opt into this profile model their section structure as DNIS Nodes; the spec-authoring renderer walks the DNIS Node graph instead of the legacy spec:Section primitives.
